text: Program Highlights The University was authorized to hold the HSK Exam in 2008. The university has maintained close links and intercollegiate cooperation with almost 80 well-known institutions of higher education in more than 30 countries such as Purdue University (USA), Canberra University(Australia), Wollongong University (Australia), University of Montreal (Canada). The university established Northern Lights Confucius Institute in Reykjavik University (Iceland). The School is committed to students’ overall development and organizes many cultural and sports activities for international students. Teaching Objectives This class is designed to teach the basics of the Chinese language (listening, speaking, reading and writing) and help students pass the HSK. Courses Main courses: Basic Chinese, Chinese Reading Comprehension, Chinese Listening Comprehension, Basic Chinese Grammar, Chinese Conversation, Selected Readings in Newspapers and Periodicals, Chinese Handwriting Practice, Basic Chinese Writing, etc.
